paths.scope: Linux/AMD64 owner-user native desktop and local service upgrade, with the exact tested schema59 starting state

validation.merge_gate: Required source, qml-offscreen and release-policy checks must pass on the final release PR head, with review and a protected merge commit. Draft download verification and publication are separate.

scope_limits: Exact Linux/AMD64 published0.4.0/schema59 to0.5.0/schema65 owner-user path. Earlier stable versions follow their documented path to0.4.0. No arbitrary old development snapshot or remote OS/service upgrade is qualified.

Authorization denial/retry in the offline service rehearsal uses an exact-program fixture. Human password entry and power-loss durability are outside that rehearsal. Native desktop cold/hot activation and failed-candidate recovery run in a separate private compositor.
Stop qualification covers the guarded native interleaving, original receipt replay, same-pier Start and peer/history preservation. It does not establish the historical incident’s exact predicate.

App qualification covers the bounded Gall sample and original Grubbery recovery/two-version/state/restart contract. Broader peers, permits, routes, served assets, publication and failure combinations remain separate.

The CLI/MCP catalog has explicit exclusions. Official SDK stdio evidence does not establish every named coding client or complete legacy parity. Named test execution is unavailable; local HTTP recipes remain experimental and remote OAuth/TLS is excluded.

Recording is an opt-in ordinary managed-launch pilot. Active-worker upgrades, existing-process adoption, other factories, host-wide oldest-output inventory, automatic deletion, age enforcement and retirement/pressure recovery are not qualified.
Resource allocation observations remain incomplete and grant no automatic containment, Stop or deletion authority. Issues16–21 retain these follow-ups; issue22 is excluded.
Only authorized DEV was updated, preserving existing manual state. Publication does not authorize any production service update.
